blockers.acceptance: The authenticated matrix observed at the frozen candidate SHA — run automatically by .github/workflows/release-candidate.yml at freeze (Stripe TEST mode, seeded non-production Supabase), or a recorded owner-accepted risk for capped beta. The a59aa4e local run (93/0/27) is a true historical pass but no longer certifies HEAD: 63 files changed across the v17 pack since that SHA, so its evidence is superseded and must be re-observed at the candidate. This is a free automated test in test mode at freeze, not a manual per-release chore, and a superseded run is never a standing closure.

acceptedRisks.rationale: Witnessed live at v16: a completed real charge (Aug 1, prior EUR price) with the subscription created, current-code checkout session creation for a brand-new user, and cancel-at-period-end with correct entitlement retention verified on the account. NOT witnessed live: completing a charge on the current EUR price and the payment-failure-to-recovery / late-failure ordering; those are covered by the v15/v16 order-resilient billing and customer-ownership contract tests (green, 1500/1500). Consequence if the residual lands: a checkout could double-bill or a recovery could mis-order, affecting one real payer until refunded. Owner accepts this for a bounded public-paid launch and directs that future release packs carry this acceptance forward rather than re-opening it as new; re-verify with one completed current-code live charge before scaling volume.
